title: Hypothesis Selection via Weighted Medians
abstract: arXiv:2610.20375v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Given $n$ distributions (hypotheses) $\mathcal H=\{H_1,\ldots,H_n\}$ and samples from an unknown target distribution $P$, proper hypothesis selection seeks a distribution whose total variation distance to $P$ is close to the best achievable within the known distributions. We give an algorithm that, using $O(\varepsilon^{-2}\log(n/\delta))$ target samples, running in $O(n\varepsilon^{-2}\log(n/\delta))$ time, with probability at least $1-\delta$, returns $H_{\hat i}$ satisfying $d_\mathrm{TV}(P,H_{\hat i})\leq 3\min_{i\in[n]}d_\mathrm{TV}(P,H_i)+\varepsilon.$ The algorithm achieves the optimal approximation factor and sample complexity. The running time improves the dependence on the failure probability from polynomial to logarithmic in the state-of-the-art bound $\tilde{O}(n\varepsilon^{-2}\delta^{-1})$ of Aamand, Aliakbarpour, Chen, and Silwal (COLT 2026), thereby answering their Question~2.

translated_title: 基于加权中位数的假设选择
translated_abstract: 给定 n 个分布（假设）$\mathcal H=\{H_1,\ldots,H_n\}$ 以及来自未知目标分布 P 的样本，适当假设选择旨在找到一个分布，使其与 P 的总变差距离接近已知分布中可达到的最佳水平。我们提出了一种算法，该算法使用 $O(\varepsilon^{-2}\log(n/\delta))$ 个目标样本，运行时间为 $O(n\varepsilon^{-2}\log(n/\delta))$，以至少 $1-\delta$ 的概率返回满足 $d_\mathrm{TV}(P,H_{\hat i})\leq 3\min_{i\in[n]}d_\mathrm{TV}(P,H_i)+\varepsilon$ 的 $H_{\hat i}$。该算法达到了最优的近似因子和样本复杂度。该算法的运行时间将 Aamand、Aliakbarpour、Chen 和 Silwal（COLT 2026）的最先进界限 $\tilde{O}(n\varepsilon^{-2}\delta^{-1})$ 中对失败概率的依赖从多项式级改进为对数级，从而回答了他们提出的问题 2。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于加权中位数的假设选择算法，在达到最优近似因子和样本复杂度的同时，将运行时间对失败概率的依赖从多项式级改进为对数级。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a hypothesis selection algorithm based on weighted medians that achieves the optimal approximation factor and sample complexity, while improving the dependence of running time on the failure probability from polynomial to logarithmic.
